title: fact
description: L2 immutable fact — the only source of a number string. Mirrors facts.json entries.

value.description: Raw float for computation; NEVER rendered into prose.

rendered.description: Python-owned display string; the writer copies it verbatim.

metric_id.description: Stable registry identity only after semantic validation; null for unmapped or rejected facts.

display_name.description: Registry-validated reader-facing name; null when the mapping is absent or rejected.

aggregation.description: Registry-validated aggregation semantics for a mapped fact.

grain.description: Registry-validated output grain for a mapped fact.

formula.description: Registry formula carried for machine validation, not inline report display.

mapping_error.description: Why a registry candidate was rejected; rejected facts keep producer rendering.
